meta.name: Swarmling (brood)

fps.crawl: ph = floor(e.wob/1.5) % 4; wob advances as it moves

meta.grafts: painted with no grafts (graft variants: Fevered, Volatile, legs... are painted on the body when the Hemomancer takes them)
meta.mirror: Frames are painted facing screen-right (face +1). The web mirrors for face -1 by flipping the image about the anchor: x -> -x (a frame at dx with width w is drawn at -(dx + w)).
meta.scale: Rendered at the desktop scale: 3 atlas px per world px (canvas RS 4 x the 0.75 world-scale creatures and heroes are drawn at). One yard (tile) = 108 x 54 px on the iso grid. Nearest-neighbour, as the web draws it; no downscale (the sprite art is painted at 1.5x-3x world grain; the web blits it at this size).
meta.anchor: Anchor (0,0) = the entity's world position projected by iso() (its ground point). (dx,dy) = offset from the anchor to the frame top-left. The web draws the ground shadow ellipse centred 2 world px (6 atlas px) below the anchor; shadows are NOT in the frames.
meta.not_exported: hatch grow-in (scaled 0.2->1), leap hop, frenzy glow, life bar
